def do_diff(label):
    b = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    c = [r.ljust(64,'.') for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n')]
    diffs = [(r,col,b[r][col],c[r][col]) for r in range(len(c)) for col in range(len(c[r])) if b[r][col]!=c[r][col]]
    nt = [d for d in diffs if d[0]!=1]
    print(label, "ndiffs:", len(nt), nt[:12])
# probe left grid cells
for (r,c) in [(36,8),(40,13),(44,18),(48,23)]:

    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    do_diff(f"rightgrid ({r},{c})")
# probe white notch bottom of right panel
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':53,'col':53}])
do_diff("notch (53,53)")
